title: Drain a pan of dumplings into the sink with both hands, holding the lid ajar
instruction: Drain the water into the sink but keep the dumplings in the pan: hold the lid slightly ajar with one hand while the other tips the pan over the sink by its handle, then set the pan back on the stove.
context: Draining pasta, potatoes or dumplings by holding the lid ajar is an everyday kitchen move: one hand tips the pan, the other holds the lid just open enough to let the water out and keep the food in. A lid that is not held slides off as the pan tips, and the food goes into the sink with the water.
setup: A table in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them. (1) A fixed dark grey stove block, 10 cm across and 13 cm tall, centred 27 cm forward and 1 cm right of the centre line. (2) On it, centred, a loose steel saucepan, inside 11 cm across and 7.5 cm deep, with a 3 mm wall and a 5 mm floor, 0.40 kg; its black handle, a bar 7 cm long, 2.5 cm wide and 2.2 cm tall, points straight back toward the arms from just under the rim. (3) Its lid, loose and centred on the rim: a flat steel disc 13.6 cm across (it overhangs the rim by 1 cm all round) and 4 mm thick, with no rim or skirt, and on top a black square knob 2.2 cm front to back, 3 cm side to side and 5.2 cm tall; 0.08 kg. (4) In the pan, six pale yellow dumplings (balls 24 mm across, 8 g each) in a ring on the floor, and the water: 20 blue beads 5 mm across, 0.5 g each. (5) A fixed white sink basin in front of the stove, inside 16 cm square and 7 cm deep, centred 41 cm forward and 1 cm right of the centre line. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial, placing each bead by its centre. 0.0 unless the pan ends standing on the stove (tilted less than 10 degrees, its centre within 4 cm of the stove's). Otherwise 1.0 with at least 16 of the 20 water beads in the sink and all 6 dumplings in the pan; 0.5 with at least 10 water beads in the sink and at least 5 dumplings in the pan; 0.25 with at least 5 water beads in the sink and all 6 dumplings in the pan; else 0.0. The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held with the pan and every bead still for 1 s.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed: put the water beads and the dumplings back in the pan, stand it on the stove with its handle pointing back, and centre the lid on it.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz control) of a calibrated two-arm table. Simplified: the water is 20 rigid 5 mm beads (they roll and pour but do not flow or splash); the dumplings are rigid 24 mm balls; the pan's wall is 28 flat panels; the lid is a plain disc with no seal; nothing is hot; friction is set (pan 0.6, lid 0.5, dumplings 0.5, water 0.2); the cameras render at 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
